test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 1000 boys and 600 girls are examined in a test. If 40% of the boys and 35% of the girls passed, then find the percentage (approximately) of the total number of candidates who failed in the test.
solution:
GIVEN:

Number of Boys = 1000

Number of Girls = 600

Percentage of boys who passed the exam = 40%

Percentage of Girls who passed the exam = 35%

FORMULA USED:

Percentage = (value / Total value) × 100%

SOLUTION:

According to the given conditions;

Number of boys who passed the exam = 40% of 1000

⇒ (40 / 100) × 1000

⇒ 400

Percentage of Girls who passed the exam = 35% of 600

⇒ (35 / 100) × 600

⇒ 210

Total number of students passed the exam = 400 + 210 = 610

So the total number of students = 1600

Then the total number of students who failed the exam = Total number of students - Total number of students passed the exam

⇒ 1600 - 610

⇒ 990

So, the percentage of the total number of candidates who failed the test = (990 / 1600) × 100

⇒ 61.88%

Hence option 1 is the valid answer.
